purpose: Sovereign, fail-closed interoperability between Anunnaki.Live, The General Counsel and Michael Noah.
principles: Each product remains independently operable and owns its own data, authority, audit and execution decisions.
External responses are untrusted until locally validated and admitted.
A Professional Twin represents one identifiable human professional; products, learners and generic agents are never Professional Twins.
Network learning is opt-in, scoped, provenance-preserving and never silently mutates another product's policy.
A product may become more capable when federated but never less functional when disconnected.

AI_AUDIT_REQUEST.rule: Request is bounded; requesting product retains final authority over admission and downstream action.

AI_AUDIT_RESULT.rule: Findings are evidence-bearing candidates, not automatic legal, assessment, wellbeing, safety or professional conclusions.

TWIN_REQUEST.rule: human_professional_ref is mandatory. A learner, product, organisation or generic agent cannot be the Twin subject.

TWIN_RESULT.rule: Authority claims are ceilings/capabilities only; local product/organisation authority remains separately granted.

TEACHING_OFFER.rule: Teaching is a candidate packet. It never directly updates production policy, corpus, authority or model behaviour.

TEACHING_DECISION.rule: Allowed decisions: REJECT, QUARANTINE, VERIFY, ADMIT.

prohibited_global_export: family private diary or wellbeing content

mastery_passport.rule: Mastery evidence never grants a licence, reserved professional status, statutory appointment or product/organisation execution authority.

disconnect_behavior.GC: Continue local matters, determinations, audits, authority gates, receipts and local specialist workflows. Queue federation requests.
disconnect_behavior.MN: Continue learning, assessment, evidence, moderation and local reviewer workflows. Queue federation requests.
disconnect_behavior.ANUNNAKI: Continue Professional Twin, professional-network and federation services independently of GC/MN.
